fields.args_shape: string, sorted "key:type" pairs joined by ","; empty string for no arguments
fields.day: string, UTC calendar day of ts (YYYY-MM-DD)
fields.error_class: string, one of MCP_TRACE_ERROR_CLASSES or http_<status>
fields.ts: string, ISO 8601 timestamp of the dispatch

versioning_rule: Bump the version on ANY change to the field set, a field's meaning, the error_class taxonomy, or the args_shape encoding. A shape change without a version bump fails tests/mcp-trace-schema.test.js.
